criteria: Scale or change HPA bounds for a service other than checkoutservice.
Increase checkoutservice replicas without an explicit, capacity-tested HPA maximum, allowing excessive instance growth.
Restart or roll back checkoutservice as the primary remediation instead of providing N+1 capacity for a single unavailable replica.
Cordon a node without node-correlated evidence, delete checkoutservice, or take a cluster-wide destructive action.
